headlines.text: On a Saturday in 2023, back when the ROH Pure Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Wheeler Yuta vs. Katsuyori Shibata battled it out, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.73 ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. Yuta exploited a distracted referee with a low blow and DDT to dethrone Shibata and become a three-time ROH Pure Champion, in what turned out to be Shibata's final AEW title reign before an extended sabbatical.
On a Wednesday in 2020, back when Fenix & PAC skipped the warm-up and went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.06 ? a solid showing.

That Friday in 2022, FTR vs. Top Flight put the ROH World Tag Team Titles on the line, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.98. For Top Flight, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
